main.description: A recurring-charge candidate meisai surfaces from the member's statement rows and hands off to kaiyaku 解約 (methods/recurring.cljc → data/kaiyaku-handoff.edn → kaiyaku meisai_ingest). meisai SURFACES only: action is always ':review' and advisory is always true — keep/sever is kaiyaku's decision (+ member-sig). PERSONAL data (reveals subscriptions): local-only, never committed/pinned/published (G1/G3). The jpyEquivalent/fx* fields are a REPORT-TIME FX view, never persisted as a Datom.

merchant.description: the merchant as it appears on the statement (a SERVICE, never a person — kaiyaku N1)

typicalAmount.description: median charge, integer minor units (native currency)

jpyEquivalent.description: REPORT-TIME FX JPY-equivalent (advisory; absent when no rate) — never a Datom

fxRate.description: JPY per 1 major unit used for jpyEquivalent
